stories.summary: Britons travelling to Spain this week face a 24-hour nationwide general strike on November 11. Unions are protesting housing costs and working conditions across all sectors. stories.summary: Israir is considering acquiring Israeli rival Arkia to create a larger airline group. stories.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration plans to eliminate floppy disks from its air traffic control systems by the end of 2028. The agency is using a $12.5 billion modernization fund to replace equipment dating back to the 1980s and 1990s with new digital display systems.

stories.summary: The FAA plans to phase out the use of floppy disks in its air traffic control systems by the end of 2028. The agency has relied on the legacy storage format for years to manage critical flight data. The technology is currently older than many of its users.

stories.summary: The FAA has activated its first digital air traffic control towers at airports in Florida and Alaska.
